answer: Make reputation a trellis: weight climbs only along sealed, quorum-matched grading verdicts a key accrues one epoch at a time. A fresh sybil is a bare lattice with no history to echo and nothing to forge, since every verdict is checked on-ledger against the eventual consensus. To fake standing you must actually grade correctly across many epochs; M clones each repay M times that labor, so attacker cost grows linearly in identities and cannot be bought or copied.
